thread:
alex: deploy-bot put the eu-west canary on hold for artifact rlm-server:2026.03.21-rc2. SBOM provenance attach timed out. can we decide pin vs rollback vs hotpatch?

alex: Deploybot log:
```
[deploy-bot] FLAG: SBOM_PROVENANCE_LAG
region=eu-west artifact=rlm-server:2026.03.21-rc2 canary=10%
reason=cosign attach timeout (http 504)
severity=medium
```

maria: looking into logs now. pinging infra team.

deploy-bot: evidence_url: https://ci.internal/redwood/artifacts/rlm-server/2026.03.21-rc2/sbom

qa-john: quick Q — any CVE or vuln flags?

alex: no CVEs, unit/integration smoke passed in canary. just missing cosign timestamp and cosign attach step failed intermittently.

pm-sam: change window ends 12:00 UTC. pin would mean rebuild+smoke (~45m). rollback would revert to previous digest but loses rc2 fixes. hotpatch would attach signature after deploy (policy question).

sre-jen: alternative: regional fallback — route canary traffic to us-east if capacity there, keep global rollout paused for eu-west until provenance cleared. less rollback risk.

maria: can we toggle that quickly? what config change is needed?

alex: yes, routing supports per-canary-region override. command: `rdwctl rollout set --artifact rlm-server:2026.03.21-rc2 --canary-region us-east`

legal: attaching signature post-deploy is disfavored but we can accept an exception for a 10% canary if: evidence is attached within 24h, ticket opened with audit details, and customers are notified. not for full prod.

qa-john: +1 to regional fallback, then run extended smoke in us-east and validate telemetry.

maria: we'll trigger fallback now and start a parallel rebuild for a pinned digest. if rebuild finishes fast we can switch back.

alex: doing the change: `rdwctl rollout set --artifact rlm-server:2026.03.21-rc2 --canary-region us-east && rdwctl rollout status --watch`

alex: changed canary region -> us-east. observing.

deploy-bot: INFO: canary routing update accepted. canary now serving from us-east (10%). eu-west hold remains.

pm-sam: decision summary so far: 1) regional fallback to us-east for canary (in progress) 2) start rebuild/pin for a provably-signed image as fallback 3) if rebuild not ready in 24h, allow hotpatch attach only for the 10% canary with legal signoff and audit ticket 4) full prod blocked until eu-west provenance verified.

sre-jen: I'll add monitoring alert to escalate if error rate >1% for 5m in us-east canary.

legal: filing conditional exception. please add the audit ticket and link it here.

maria: created ticket INFRA-5421 with details and assigned to deploy-team. link: https://tickets.internal/INFRA-5421

qa-john: running extended smoke now. will report back in 10m.

pm-sam: also update release notes to reflect the staging fallback and note the provenance attach issue under known issues so internal teams are aware.

alex: noted. updating changelog: `Changelog: rc2: regional canary fallback applied for eu-west provenance attach delay. No behavior changes. Monitoring enabled.`

maria: thumbs up — :thumbsup:

qa-john: smoke passed in us-east. no regressions seen.

pm-sam: ok proceed with canary in us-east. keep eu-west blocked. open item: attach cosign evidence within 24h or trigger rollback. I'll own the rollback decision at 24h cutoff.

alex: will keep thread updated. closing for now but will post if anything changes.
